items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I had a drummer named Sonny Christian.

ctx.x: That's pretty interesting. Yeah, that handle on the side, you know.

And they were all drinking beer. I had a drummer named Sonny Christian. I don't know if you ever knew him. No, I never knew him. He was from Baltimore. So the man said, where's your, where's your, where's your, pot? Glover. He called me Glover. And I said, well, Your Honor, I haven't got any. Didn't bring me any. He said, they didn't. And I said, no, they didn't, Your Honor. So he said, well, come in and get mine. And he was over on the rails of the boat. So I left the piano, one of them got to get his. And he…
I heard there was some killing down there at the Pekin once. Yeah, Hachimilla. I think Joe Oliver was playing there then, I believe somebody told me. Joe Oliver's band was working.
